test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: After allowing a discount of 80%, the value of an oven is ₹5,180. If no discount is allowed, then the shopkeeper gains 48%. Find the cost price (in ₹) of the oven.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Value after **80% discount** (20% of MP) = 5,180.

**Marked Price (MP)** = 5,180 × 100 ÷ 20 = 25,900.

If no discount is allowed, **Selling Price (SP) = MP** = 25,900.

At this price, **Gain%** = 48%, so 148% of CP = 25,900.

**Cost Price (CP)** = 25,900 ÷ 1.48 = 17,500.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹17,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Discount = 80%, SP = ₹5,180. Profit (if SP=MP) = 48%.

**Formulas:** MP = [SP × 100] ÷ [100 − Discount%], CP = [SP × 100] ÷ [100 + Profit%].

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a698108e0a656b3946609912dc0dc28fe273fddaa013498384639df060f17d20.png] 

⇒ **Step 1:** Calculate MP using the discounted value. MP = (5,180 × 100) ÷ (100 − 80) = 518,000 ÷ 20 = **25,900**.

⇒ **Step 2:** When no discount is given, New SP = MP = 25,900.

⇒ **Step 3:** Use the profit percentage to find CP. CP = (25,900 × 100) ÷ (100 + 48) = 2,590,000 ÷ 148.

⇒ **Step 4:** CP = **17,500**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹17,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Marked Price is the price printed on the label. Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price**. SP = MP − Discount.

Relation between CP and MP

The direct formula relating CP and MP is: CP ÷ MP = (100 − D%) ÷ (100 + P%).
